title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: STEERING GEAR REPLACEMENT (130 affected)
summary: VW IS RECALLING 130 MY 2009 PASSAT, PASSAT WAGON, AND PASSAT CC VEHICLES.  SOME VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN ELECTROMECHANICAL STEERING GEAR CONTROL UNIT THAT CAN MALFUNCTION DUE TO A DAMAGED CAPACITOR. title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: FRONT STRUT (1,515 affected)

title: AMERICAN LAFRANCE LLC: VEHICLE CAB HYDRAULIC LIFT SYSTEM (1,251 affected)
summary: AMERICAN LAFRANCE IS RECALLING 1,251 MY 2000-2007 CONDOR TRUCKS.  THE BRACKET THAT ATTACHES THE HYDRAULIC CYLINDER TO THE CAB USED TO RAISE AND LOWER THE VEHICLE CAB FOR MAINTENANCE ACTIVITIES CAN FAIL.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: POWER STEERING HOSE (640 affected)
summary: PREVOST IS RECALLING 395 MY 2007-2009 MTH XL2-45, MTH XL2-45E, AND X3-45 MOTOR HOMES AND MOTOR COACHES.  ON SOME VEHICLES, THE POWER STEERING HOSE PROTECTIVE SKIN HAS BEEN DAMAGED AT ASSEMBLY, LEAVING THE METAL BRAIDING EXPOSED TO THE ENVIRONMENT.

title: Eldorado National-Kansas: FMVSS 403/ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK/RICON (850 affected)
summary: ELDORADO NATIONAL (ENK) IS RECALLING 850 MY 2005-2008 AERO ELITE, AEROLITE, AEROTECH, AND MY 2006-2008 TRANSTECH BUSES EQUIPPED WITH RICON PLATFORM STYLE WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.  THESE LIFTS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 403, "PLATFORM LIFT SYSTEMS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES."  THE ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK MAY NOT DETECT THE PRESENCE OF A WHEELCHAIR OR MOBILITY AID USER.  THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS THE PRESENCE OF WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM WAS NOT ADJUSTED TO THE NECESSARY SENSITIVITY LEVEL.  THE LIFT COULD STOW EVEN THOUGH SOMEONE OR SOMETHING IS STILL ON THE LIFT.

title: Autocar, LLC: FMVSS 121/BRAKE TIMING (33 affected)
summary: AUTOCAR IS RECALLING 103 MY 2008-2009 ACX HEAVY-DUTY CLASS 8 VEHICLES WITH RIGHT-HAND DRIVE.  THESE VEHICLES FAIL TO CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 121, 'AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS.'  THE AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS TIMING SPECIFICATIONS ARE NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE STANDARD.

title: Hino Motors Sales U.S.A., Inc.: SUPPLY PUMP COUPLER (3,836 affected)
summary: HINO IS RECALLING 3,836 MY 2008 ND8J, NE8J, NJ8J, AND NV8J CLASS 6 AND 7, CONVENTIONAL CAB, MEDIUM DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPED WITH J08E-TV OR J08E-TW ENGINES.   THERE IS AN IMPROPER SHAPE OF THE SUPPLY PUMP COUPLER LOCATED BETWEEN THE SUPPLY PUMP AND THE AIR COMPRESSOR.  THE COUPLING MAY CRACK, THE GEAR TRAIN AND VALVES OF THE ENGINE COULD BREAK, AND THE ENGINE COULD STOP RUNNING.

title: General Motors, LLC: FMVSS 209/SAFETY BELT BUCKLE ASSEMBLY (16,667 affected)
summary: GM IS RECALLING 16,667 MY 2009 BUICK ENCLAVE, CHEVROLET TRAVERSE, GMC ACADIA, AND SATURN OUTLOOK VEHICLES FOR FAILING TO CONFORM WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 209, 'SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES.'  THESE VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH A SAFETY BELT BUCKLE IN THE SECOND OR THIRD ROW THAT IS MISSING A RIVET.

title: General Motors, LLC: INCORRECT STEERING KNUCKLE (2,149 affected)
summary: GM IS RECALLING 2,149 MY 2009 SATURN VUE VEHICLES.  SOME OF THESE VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH AN INCORRECT RIGHT AND/OR LEFT FRONT STEERING KNUCKLE.  AS A RESULT OF THE INCORRECT KNUCKLE AND RESULTING INADEQUATE CLEARANCE, THE TIE ROD BALL STUD COULD PULL OUT OF, OR FRACTURE, THE TIE ROD HOUSING.  THIS COULD CAUSE THE TIE ROD TO SEPARATE FROM THE KNUCKLE.

title: UD Trucks Corporation: FUEL INJECTION PUMP DRIVE COUPLER (549 affected)
summary: NISSAN DIESEL IS RECALLING 549 MY 2008 UD1800, UD2000, UD2300, UD2600, AND UD3300 MEDIUM DUTY TRUCKS.  A FAILURE OF THE FUEL INJECTION PUMP DRIVE COUPLER CAN OCCUR.  THE BOTTOM CORNER OF THE NOTCHED DRIVE SURFACE WAS IMPROPERLY MACHINED.  WITH INCREASED FUEL PUMP PRESSURE, THE REQUIRED TURNING TORQUE ON THE DRIVE COUPLER INCREASED.  THE INCREASED TURNING TORQUE COULD CRACK THE COUPLER AT THE BOTTOM CORNER WITHOUT WARNING UNDER NORMAL VEHICLE OPERATION.

title: International Motors, LLC: BRAKE AIR LINE (14,048 affected)
summary: NAVISTAR IS RECALLING 14,048 MY 2008-2010 LONESTAR AND PROSTAR TRUCKS.  THE SERVICE BRAKE AIR LINE THAT RUNS FROM THE TRACTOR PROTECTION VALVE TO THE FAST BRAKE MODULE MAY SEPARATE FROM THE FAST BRAKE MODULE RESULTING IN LOSS OF TRAILER SERVICE BRAKES.

title: International Motors, LLC: FRONT AXLE BEARINGS (977 affected)
summary: NAVISTAR IS RECALLING 977 MY 2009 INTERNATIONAL 3200, 4100, 4300, 4400 TRUCKS AND IC BUS HC COMMERCIAL BUSES.  THE FRONT AXLE BEARINGS IN SOME CASES WERE NOT SUFFICIENTLY LUBRICATED DURING ASSEMBLY WHICH MAY RESULT IN BEARING SEIZING OR POSSIBLE WHEEL SEPARATION.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: PROPANE HOSE CONNECTIONS (106 affected)
summary: FLEETWOOD IS RECALLING 106 MY 2009 ICON AND PULSE 24A MOTOR HOMES.  THE PROPANE HOSE CONNECTIONS MAY BE INSTALLED IN A POSITION THAT CAUSES THEM TO BECOME PINCHED AGAINST THE PROPANE TANK.

title: M H Eby, Inc.: WHEEL STUDS/ARVINMERITOR (1 affected)
summary: M. H. EBY RECALLED 1 MY 2009 SM1GLP GROUND LOADER TRAILER EQUIPPED WITH ARVINMERITOR AXLE ASSEMBLIES WITH SUSPECT WHEEL END STUDS.  THE WHEEL END STUDS WERE IMPROPERLY TEMPERED, POTENTIALLY RENDERING THEM BRITTLE AND SUSCEPTIBLE TO FRACTURE.  IF ONE WHEEL STUD FRACTURES, THE REMAINING WHEEL STUDS ARE REQUIRED TO CARRY MORE LOAD.  IF LEFT IN THIS CONDITION, THE REMAINING WHEEL STUDS MAY ALSO FRACTURE EVEN IF THEY ARE PROPERLY MANUFACTURED.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: DUAL POWER SWITCH (18,198 affected)
summary: DAIMLER TRUCKS IS RECALLING 18,198 MY 2003-2009 THOMAS BUILT ER, MVP-ER, HDX, AND MVP-EF SCHOOL AND TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH A DUAL POWER SWITCH AND MANUFACTURED FROM FEBRUARY 1, 2002 THROUGH OCTOBER 17, 2008.  SOLID STATE CIRCUIT BREAKERS MAY TRIP UNNECESSARILY POTENTIALLY RESULTING IN A LOSS OF POWER TO THE BUS CHASSIS AND BODY ELECTRICAL CIRCUITS CAUSING AN UNEXPECTED LOSS OF ENGINE POWER AND EXTERIOR LIGHTING.

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A.: REAR BRAKE PEDAL (4,628 affected)
summary: KAWASAKI IS RECALLING 4,628 MY ZG1400A8F/A8FL, AND ZG1400B8F/B8FL MOTORCYCLES.  TRAPPED ROAD DEBRIS MAY INTERFERE WITH FREE MOVEMENT OF THE REAR BRAKE PEDAL, PREVENTING FULL RELEASE OF THE REAR BRAKE WHICH CAN LEAD TO OVERHEATING DAMAGE AND POSSIBLE BRAKE FAILURE.

title: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd.: FRONT BRAKE CALIPER BOLT (87 affected)
summary: TRIUMPH IS RECALLING 87 MY 2008-2009 THRUXTON MOTORCYCLES.  THE INSTALLED FRONT BRAKE CALIPER BRACKET BOLTS MAY BE TOO SHORT, REDUCING THREAD ENGAGEMENT OF THE BOLTS INTO THE BRAKE CALIPER BRACKET.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: FUEL TANK VENT TUBE ASSEMBLY (349 affected)
summary: HARLEY-DAVIDSON IS RECALLING 349 MY 2009 FXDB, FXDC, FXDF, AND FXDL MOTORCYCLES.  THESE MOTORCYCLES HAVE A FUEL TANK VENT TUBE ASSEMBLY, PART NO. 27389-04A, WHICH MAY HAVE BEEN PRODUCED WITH A DEFECTIVE ULTRASONIC WELD ON THE ANTI-SLOSH VALVE.

title: Claire's Recalls Children's Metal Necklaces Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The recalled necklaces contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 67,000.

title: OKK Trading Recalls Toy TVs Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface coating on the toy television could contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 2,100.

title: Sherwin-Williams Co. Recalls Krylon UV Fabric Protector Due to Respiratory Hazard
summary: Overexposure to fumes, vapor or spray mist from the product can pose a serious respiratory hazard to consumers. Units: About 75,000.

title: Toy Xylophones Recalled by King Import Warehouse Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the toy xylophone contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 144.

title: Candela Recalls Candles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Anthropologie Stores
summary: The candle flames could flare up out of the tin container during the burning of the last half inch of wax, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 225.

title: ImagiPLAY Recalls Bead Maze Toys Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The trees on the toys can detach, exposing a metal screw. This poses a laceration hazard to young children. Units: About 500.

title: Near Strangulation of Child Prompts Recall to Repair Window Blinds by Green Mountain Vista
summary: The black-out roller shades and insulated Roman shades have a continuous looped bead chain that when not attached to the wall or floor, hangs loosely by the blind, posing a fatal strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 7,300.

title: Strangulation Death of a Child Prompts Recall of Roman Blinds; Sold Exclusively at IKEA
summary: Strangulations can occur when a child places his/her neck in an exposed inner cord on the backside of the roman blinds. Units: About 670,000 (an additional 4.8 million were sold outside of the United States).

title: Watts Water Technologies Recalls Rotor and Shaft Assemblies Due to Fire Hazard
summary: If the assembly was installed in a fire suppression system and remained in a closed position, sufficient water might not have been available in the event of a fire. This posed a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 15.

title: Brownie's Third Lung Recalls Air Compressors Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The air compressor's components can fail, which could cause a stoppage of air flow. This poses a risk of drowning to users. Units: About 1,000.

title: Children's Hooded Jackets with Drawstrings Recalled by R&D International Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The jackets have drawstrings through the hood and at the waist. Children can get entangled in the drawstrings that can catch on playground equipment, fences or tree branches. Units: About 1,500.

title: Target Recalls Dive Sticks Due to Impalement Hazard
summary: The recalled dive sticks could remain in an upright position, posing an impalement hazard to young children. Units: About 365,000.

title: GE Recalls to Inspect and Repair Wall Ovens Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The extreme heat used in the self-clean cycle can escape, if the wall oven door is removed and incorrectly re-attached by the installer or the consumer. This can pose a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 244,000.

title: Lithium-Ion Batteries Used with Bicycle Lights Recalled By DiNotte Lighting Due to Burn Hazard
summary: A loose wiring connection and improper venting can cause the battery to overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,700.

title: Cobra Electronics Recalls Children's Two-Way Radios with Rechargeable Batteries Due to Chemical Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively in Toys "R" Us Stores
summary: The rechargeable batteries in the radios can leak electrolyte, posing a chemical burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 8,000.

title: JA-RU Recalls Toy Trains Due To Choking Hazard
summary: The recalled toy contain small parts which can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 18,000.

title: Lighted Showcases Recalled by Seventh Avenue Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lighted showcase's plug adaptor can overheat and melt the adaptor's plastic housing, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 700.

title: Off-Road Motorcycles Recalled by American Honda Motor Due to Risk of Swing Arm Weld Failure
summary: The weld on the right side of the swing arm can fail, causing the rider to lose control and crash. This could pose a risk of injury or death to riders. Units: About 13,000.

title: Swim 'N Score Dive Sticks Recalled by Modell's Due to Risk of Impalement Injury to Children
summary: Children can fall or land on these dive sticks in shallow water and suffer impalement injuries. Eye and other facial injuries are also possible. Units: About 130.

title: Stainless Steel Pots Recalled by Ocean State Jobbers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The stainless steel pots have metal handles that can detach during use, posing a serious burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,000.

title: Heavy Duty Acidic Cleaner Recalled by DuPont Due to Leaking Cap; Poses Risk of Severe Skin Irritation
summary: Pressure can build up in a full or nearly full bottle of the acidic cleaner when it is stored in elevated temperatures over an extended period of time, which can result in the cleaner leaking from underneath the cap. If the product comes into contact with skin, it can cause severe skin irritation. U

title: JCPenney Recalls Arizona® Newborn and Infant Pants Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The metal snap at the waist can detach posing a choking hazard to infants. Units: About 24,000.
